recent_excerpts: CISA added CVE-2026-42016, a JFrog Artifactory token-scope authorization flaw enabling privilege escalation, to its KEV catalog with a Sept 25 patch deadline.
CVE-2026-81963 and CVE-2026-85880 are Windows EoP zero-days exploited before patch. Microsoft's Sept 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes a record 964 CVEs—patch now.
CISA gives federal agencies until Aug 25 to patch CVE-2026-68820, a Winsock privilege-escalation flaw exploited by North Korea's Lazarus in Operation Dream Job.
